n: Expenses: one title in the page header (Expenses · Summary, to the cut), one toolbar row, one ⇩ Export to Excel in the command bar
Period and Source are pick lists; the help line is behind ⓘ; fold / open all are ⊟ ⊞ at the start of the toolbar
New menu: MONTH CLOSE (1 Update · 2 Code · 3 Decide · 4 Forecast, each with a badge) · REPORTS · SETTINGS – always with words; ☰ folds it to a thin rail for more table width
On top of each page: one command bar (Update SAP files · Undo · Export · ‹ back · Next ›) and a header with the key figures of the step
The pages of a step are tabs above the table (Code: Material 538 · Subcontractor 97 …), the groups in a Group pick list; a step opens on its first open task
Your company logo in the header and on a new start page built around the 4 steps
Budget: the Direct plan is read by its item totals (Takeoff, EV Q.) – no building columns needed; an item's PKG comes from the Cost Analysis
Progress: one done quantity per BOQ item (take-off, done to date, left, % done) – a split by building typed before counts as its sum

Another cost report layout: when a column is not found, Match the columns opens with the tool's guesses – pick the red ones; BAC and EV are checked against the file; kept for next time · Check the columns… on the Budget page
Budget: reads a cost report in a second layout too – per building "B04 Takeoff" / "B04 EV Q." and one Cost Analysis header row ("CSI Code (PKG)", items at level 4, resources at level 5)
Division rows that carry an item code are read as headings and give the PKG its name
Built-in indirect list: 30605800 Location service → SE-12 Surveying Equipment · 32000039 DC-Furn. & Fixture → SP-09 · 32000057 ACs & Computers and 32000056 IT Equip&Telec. Dev. → SP-15
Items with an empty cost element get it from the list; a code you typed stays
Excel export › Lines: a Name (CJI3) column next to Description
The Lines sheet still reads back with Import codes – a PKG, MNL or cost element typed on a line comes back for that line
New report: Reports › Client › Client invoices – every client invoice in CJI3 (billing documents RV) and the opening balance
Tab 1 · Invoice register: by month, one row per invoice with gross, each client deduction GL and net, cumulative · click an invoice for its lines by WBS
Tab 2 · WBS × month: following the WBS structure, net invoiced per month, cost to date on that WBS and below, margin and % · WBS never invoiced together in one row · ⇩ Excel
Mapping rules › 2 · Indirect rules can be changed: ✕ takes a GL off a cost element, + GL adds one, and a GL not on the list yet gets a cost element from its pick list
The items coded by the list follow the change (a code you typed yourself stays) · one Ctrl+Z undoes it · kept in the data file and the Changes log · Reset to built-in
A register built before the rules changed tells you: Mapping rules shows the lines the new rules put elsewhere and ↻ Rebuild with the current rules (from the SAP files in your data file, codes kept)
3 · Your rules › Apply rules – rebuild now uses the SAP files in your data file

Client deductions: every GL 30402xxx (Client-Deductions, Liquid Damage LDFD, Poor workmanship, Utilites, penalty) and RV lines with a positive amount (not on revenue GLs 4…) go to Revenue › Client deductions
Each client deduction shows its GL name: on the Summary (one row per GL), in Adjustment lines (Why) and in Mapping rules
A simpler menu: the month is 4 steps – 1 Update · 2 Code · 3 Decide · 4 Forecast – each with where it stands
Data in: the SAP files and the months they cover against the cut (gold line) – click it for the Data log
Reports: one menu for every report (Cost · Budget · Subcontract · Material); Data log, PKG names, VAT and the data file are under ⋯ More
Mapping rules: every bucket with the rules that fill it in plain words, GL name + number, and the lines each one catches (click to see them) · indirect cost elements on tab 2 · ⇩ Excel
The new ZSCPRG01 output (with BUn and SC Type) replaces ZSCSRV1: unit and type of works come from the certificates
The PO title is the PO's type of works · ZSCSRV1 is optional – dropped with the files, it is still used
Coding follows your cost report: the PKG list shows its PKGs with their names (S03 · CONCRETE (STR-03)), tagged budget
The cost element list of a budget PKG starts with its budget resources (of the row's MNL) with their BAC – pick one so the cost lands on its budget
Budget: a search box on every page – it looks in every column
Cost Analysis opens on All PKGs; an MNL column (MAT / SUB / LAB / EQU) on Cost Analysis and the PKG pages
Budget: a filter under every column – text, or >1000 / <0 for numbers; sums follow
All PKGs grouped as in your report (Civil · Arch · MEP) with dashed borders and a sum per group
New tab Cost Analysis: each BOQ item with its resources – usage, waste, rates by type, budget rate, BAC, EV
New section Budget: read your cost report (Direct plan + Cost Analysis, .xlsb or .xlsx) – budget per PKG and resource
PKG pages like your S-sheets: budget, earned value, actuals from your coding, add / omission, provision, ETC (qty × rate), EAC, VAC, actual losses
Progress: done qty per BOQ item and building type; All PKGs summary; Excel: a Budget summary tab and a tab per PKG
Include VAT before date: the date box sits on its own line under the VAT list – no longer hidden at the edge of the side navigation

The earlier Material and Subcontractor reports: codes come from their Data tab – each item takes the code that carries most of its amount, a line coded differently keeps its own; the Coding sheet only where the Data tab has nothing
A row you code under a filter stays in the list (marked yellow) until you change the filter – or press Refresh
Enter and Ctrl+D always move on to the next row
Import codes… takes several files at once (e.g. the Material report and the Subcontractor report)
Create the register with several last reports – e.g. the Material report and the Subcontractor report together; the codes of all of them come in
The earlier Material report: its Data tab codes each issue line (Material doc.) – a line coded other than its material keeps its own code
A report of another project asks before its codes are read
Codes › PKG list shows the whole list – no filter buttons; a PKG without a name says "No name yet" on its row
You choose when to update: a new version shows in the top bar with What's new, Update and Later – nothing changes until you press Update
Your data file is never touched by an update
Monthly job: step 4 opens what is still open; step 5 has Export the monthly report
